column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.90.
# THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE. CM051 VENDORS IT.
# CM051 scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh copies this file into cuts/v1.0.90/ there and
# records the OS003 commit it came from in cuts/BOM_PIN.
# WHY THIS CUT EXISTS
# v1.0.89 aborted on a freshly wiped Mac with ERR-04-HOMEBREW-INSTALL. The
# manual, no-sudo tarball install path in install.sh (taken when OSTLER_GUI=1
# and /opt/homebrew is pre-chowned but sudo cannot be used non-interactively)
# fetched https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/tarball/master. curl succeeded and
# tar extracted fine, but the very next command, /opt/homebrew/bin/brew
# --version, exited 1 with "Error: Homebrew's master branch is no longer
# supported. Run brew update to migrate to the main branch." and install.sh
# aborted at the homebrew_install step. Every customer installing on a Mac
# without Homebrew already present hit this -- it is not an edge case.
# CM051 #1920 (merge commit ac0b5d518b557494e9450256bbfeb76780a2e563) changes
# the single curl line to fetch tarball/main instead, and adds
# tests/test_a_manual_brew_tarball_must_target_a_branch_that_still_exists.sh,
# wired into CI via tests/TEST_WIRING.tsv (WIRED,
# .github/workflows/tests-unwired-sweep-al.yml). The diff at that commit is
# exactly the one line: `tarball/master` to `tarball/main`, nothing else in
# install.sh moved.
# WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT A ROW
# Nothing else moves in this cut. No daemon re-pin (DAEMON_COMMIT stays
# wiki image rebuild, no walk-instrument change. This cut carries exactly one
# fix and the test that guards it.
what

THE MANUAL HOMEBREW TARBALL INSTALL PATH MUST TARGET A BRANCH THAT STILL EXISTS. install.sh's no-sudo tarball fallback fetched https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/tarball/master; Homebrew retired that branch, so brew --version exited 1 immediately after extraction with a migrate-to-main error and install.sh aborted at ERR-04-HOMEBREW-INSTALL on every customer Mac without Homebrew already present. Fixed by changing the one curl line to tarball/main. Guarded by tests/test_a_manual_brew_tarball_must_target_a_branch_that_still_exists.sh, WIRED per tests/TEST_WIRING.tsv.
